title: Why agents need a map before they move
dek: A short example of the Blend editorial layout: hero, prose, pull quote, callout and a diagram.

blocks.p: Illustrative text. Teams that give an agent a clear description of the work before it starts spend less time correcting it afterwards. The pattern is simple: write down the goal, the constraints and the acceptance check.

blocks.quote: The agent is only as good as the map it was handed.

blocks.p: A second paragraph keeps the measure honest: line length stays between sixty and eighty characters so the eye can return to the next line without effort.

blocks.callout: Takeaway. Write the acceptance check before the first prompt.

blocks.p: The diagram below shows the loop. All numbers and names are illustrative.
